summary_1line: Damayanti sends Brahmanas to search for Nala; a report from Ayodhya hints that the disguised charioteer Vahuka may be Nala, prompting her secret plan.

image_candidates.scene_text: Damayanti, tearful yet resolute, instructs assembled Brahmanas to proclaim her lament for the husband who abandoned her in the forest.
In Ayodhya’s court, the misshapen charioteer Vahuka quietly weeps while speaking about the duty of a chaste wife.
Damayanti privately urges Sudeva to ride swiftly to Ayodhya with the false announcement of her second swayamvara.
